result:
Fixed the seed collision. The replica pre-seeds the six default people, so my `person` ops re-created `U_PRIYA` and violated the primary key.

What changed in `scenario.json` (request, conditions, query, decoys, and write are untouched):
- Seed now creates two brand-new users instead of redefining defaults: Kira Novak (`kira`, workspace admin) and Tomas Reyes (`tomas`, regular member).
- Kira replaces Priya everywhere a guaranteed admin mattered: author of the target and all four admin-authored decoy witnesses, and a member of all five test channels (member counts unchanged: 5/6/4/5/5 including the actor bot).
- Tomas (explicit member) authors the role decoy `@drole`; its explanation now names Tomas Reyes.
- Default users (diego, leo, maya, aisha) remain only as channel filler members and filler-message authors, where their workspace role decides nothing — those records fail at least the text and member-count conditions regardless.
